values.title: Introducing typed realtime queries
values.summary: Subscribe to any query with full type inference.
values.body:
## Live queries, with types

Until now, subscribing to changes meant hand-writing event payload types. In Tessera 2.0 you subscribe to any query, and the result is typed exactly like a normal read.

Presence and broadcast channels use the same system, so multiplayer features stay type-safe.

## Getting started

Call subscribe on any query. Reconnects, ordering, and cleanup are handled for you.
